settings._title: Perched atop Eola Hills on 4.89 beautifu
settings.editor: Perched atop Eola Hills on 4.89 beautifully landscaped acres in a peaceful rural setting, this custom 3,112 Sq Ft home designed by a Street of Dreams architect blends refined living, territorial/Mt. Hood views, and exceptional versatility. Beyond the home, the property offers a substantial monitor-style barn, up to 7 stalls, surrounded by cross-fenced pastures on level ground. An oversized three-car garage with a 40-foot, two-story RV bay with hookups, and a detached Craftsman’s woodworking shop/studio make this a truly one-of-a-kind property in Oregon Wine Country.
Space, Privacy and Versatility
Thoughtfully designed living spaces with character and presence.

settings._title: As you approach the home, a circular dri
settings.editor: As you approach the home, a circular drive with finished concrete curbing leads to an impressive two-story stone entry and natural slate porch, creating a memorable first impression. Step inside to a soaring foyer with an artisan-inspired chandelier, a dramatic upper catwalk, custom millwork including crown molding, and abundant natural light that sets the tone. The two-story living room features a floor-to-ceiling stacked-stone chimney with a gas fireplace and an architectural window wall with pastoral country views.

settings._title: The well-appointed kitchen features a la
settings.editor: The well-appointed kitchen features a large center island, full-height cherry cabinets, a walk-in pantry, an under-counter ice machine, stainless-steel KitchenAid appliances, including a free-standing refrigerator, a built-in convection oven, and a gas cooktop with retractable downdraft ventilation. A wall of windows frames country views, while convenient access to the laundry room, covered deck, and BBQ area adds everyday practicality. The adjoining dining room offers options for both casual dining and entertaining.

settings._title: Three bedrooms, three full baths, and a
settings.editor: Three bedrooms, three full baths, and a dedicated office provide flexibility for everyday living. The primary suite enjoys territorial views, a walk-in closet, and an en suite bath with double sinks, a Jacuzzi tub, and a tiled walk-in shower. A main-level bedroom with an adjacent full bath creates a comfortable option for multi-generational and single-level living. The custom office with built-in cabinetry and a spacious laundry room with a dedicated work/hobby area add thoughtful function and organization to everyday living.
Open space, mature landscaping, natural rock features and usable acreage create opportunities for recreation, gardening, animals, hobbies or simply more room to breathe.

settings._title: Room for hobbies, projects, storage or l
settings.editor: Room for hobbies, projects, storage or lifestyle needs.

Thoughtfully designed for both practicality and flexibility, the impressive 2,305 SF monitor-style barn sits on a 48' x 48' concrete pad and features up to seven stalls, Dutch doors, loft, large sliding doors, covered paddock areas, equipment storage, and trailer parking. An insulated ceiling, durable metal roof, power, and water enhance its functionality, while a full bath with an exterior entrance adds convenience. The barn also features a versatile workshop area with a refrigerator, counter space, and built-in cabinets. Set on level ground and surrounded by cross-fenced pastures, this exceptional setting offers endless possibilities for livestock, hobby farming, agricultural pursuits, and a variety of recreational uses. Think party barn!

settings._title: Originally designed as a woodworking sho
settings.editor: Originally designed as a woodworking shop, this detached 435 SF (29' x 15') structure offers exceptional versatility for creative pursuits, hobbies, yoga/art studio, or workshop activities. The space feels large and bright with 11-foot ceilings, full-light French doors, windows, and fluorescent workshop lighting with protective covers. Additional amenities include: custom-built cabinetry and counter space, tool hangers, lumber racks, commercial-grade flooring, and four mounted compressed-air quick-connect fittings. The workshop is also equipped with a dedicated electrical panel and has a 240-volt/20-amp outlet.

settings._title: Conveniently connected to the home by a
settings.editor: Conveniently connected to the home by a covered breezeway, this detached 1,498 SF garage features an extra-deep, oversized three-car garage and a two-story RV bay that accommodates an RV up to 40 feet. The RV bay features a tall roll-up door, indoor electrical hookup, and a dedicated driveway with an additional full RV hookup outside. Offering generous space for vehicles, recreational equipment, storage, and workshop activities, this versatile structure provides exceptional functionality for a variety of needs.

Professionally landscaped and irrigated grounds, a custom water feature with natural boulders and architectural stone centerpiece, expansive covered back deck, and a fire pit create inviting year-round spaces to enjoy the quiet Oregon Wine Country setting.
Covered Deck · Mature Trees & Landscaping · Private Setting · Oregon Territorial Views
